rooms.name: Assassins’ Guild · study

hotspots.title: The hearth
hotspots.text: A dog sleeps beside the hearth. You give it room and keep your boots off the polished fender.

hotspots.title: Study and books
hotspots.text: The study books are well used; the furniture has been cared for. Neither invites careless handling.

hotspots.title: Speak with Lord Downey
hotspots.text: Good day, officer. Tell me the purpose of your visit. We can be precise without raising our voices.

rooms.lore: P1 library/gallery and P3 Hogfather study furnishings. This scene is the study interpretation, not the royal portrait gallery. Landscape paintings and ornamental fittings are original choices.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Original production staging informed by Quill; not a canonical headquarters floor plan.

rooms.name: Thieves’ Guild · registry

hotspots.title: Registry counter
hotspots.text: Entries and receipts cover the counter. You can see paperwork; you cannot tell from here what any particular transaction concerned.

hotspots.title: Practice locks
hotspots.text: The practice locks are worn around their keyholes. You leave them in place.

hotspots.title: Speak with Boggis
hotspots.text: Watch business? Give me a name, a place and a time. ‘Looked suspicious’ is not much to work with.

rooms.lore: P2 supports columns, secondary supports training. Column count/material/order, civic floor plan, counter and training apparatus are original staging. No blanket Watch access or legal immunity inferred.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Original differentiated production staging informed by current Quill report; not a canonical headquarters floor plan.
rooms.spatialIdentity: Asymmetric civic registry, green baize counter, cool slate, columned practice alcove.

rooms.name: Fools’ Guild · Hall of Faces

hotspots.title: The face records
hotspots.text: Painted eggs preserve distinct clown faces behind glass. You keep your hands away from the cabinet.

hotspots.title: Records lectern
hotspots.text: The lectern stands at the gallery’s cold end. You can consult the contact without touching the records.

hotspots.title: Speak with Doctor Whiteface
hotspots.text: State your business, please. This is a place of records. Take care around the glass.

rooms.lore: Secondary gaunt/oppressive institution and Hall of Faces egg archive. Long gallery plan, stone palette, lectern, decorative small faces and banner original; no heraldry certified.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Original differentiated production staging informed by current Quill report; not a canonical headquarters floor plan.
rooms.spatialIdentity: Long severe stone archive, cold narrow windows, one protected egg-record cabinet, no carpet.

rooms.name: Beggars’ Guild · reception

hotspots.title: Public counter
hotspots.text: The public counter has been patched and repaired. Wear on a desk tells you little about the person behind it.

hotspots.title: Office records
hotspots.text: Papers and locked boxes are kept in order in the office. Their contents remain private from this side of the desk.

hotspots.title: Speak with Queen Molly
hotspots.text: Come to the point, officer. Tell me what you have actually seen, and leave the rest until afterwards.

rooms.lore: Secondary institution/wealth lead. Contrast of public reception and maintained office is original production staging, not a canonical floor plan or a claim of destitution.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Original differentiated production staging informed by current Quill report; not a canonical headquarters floor plan.
rooms.spatialIdentity: Patched public waiting strip and maintained green office, connected by lattice arch; asymmetric footprint.

rooms.name: Musicians’ Guild · upstairs rooms

hotspots.title: Instrument cases
hotspots.text: Instrument cases fit tightly beneath the bench. You choose a place for your feet that leaves their catches clear.

hotspots.title: Registration desk
hotspots.text: Registration papers crowd the small desk. The clerk keeps a hand on the page while you speak.

hotspots.title: Speak with the registrations clerk
hotspots.text: Give me a name if you have one. If all you have is a description of the tune, please spare me the whistling.

rooms.lore: P2 Soul Music earlier scene: two small rooms above a barber and brown waiting-room walls. Partition, stair-head, fittings and exact plan original; no later relocation asserted.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Original differentiated production staging informed by current Quill report; not a canonical headquarters floor plan.
rooms.spatialIdentity: Two small brown upstairs offices; bent circulation through a partition opening; cool flat daylight.

rooms.name: Alchemists’ Guild · workroom

hotspots.title: Apparatus island
hotspots.text: Retorts and balances crowd the workbench. You observe without lifting, uncorking or tasting anything.

hotspots.title: Laboratory furnace
hotspots.text: Soot and replacement brickwork mark the furnace. Repairs are visible; the cause of each one is not.

hotspots.title: Speak with the laboratory assistant
hotspots.text: You can ask from there. Please leave the apparatus where it is, particularly while I am trying to remember what is in it.

rooms.lore: Current Quill P4 Moving Pictures: earlier repeated rebuilding and omitted lecture/demonstration room. This is an original later workroom, not a presumed reinstated lecture hall. Materials, furnace and island original. Closed service door is not a traversable exit.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Original differentiated production staging informed by current Quill report; not a canonical headquarters floor plan.
rooms.spatialIdentity: Repaired mismatched work bay, central apparatus island, soot furnace, chalk and copper; service wing behind closed door remains scenery.

rooms.name: Butchers’ Guild · hall

hotspots.title: Records hatch
hotspots.text: The records hatch separates guild paperwork from the hall. It is not a meat counter.

hotspots.title: Meeting table
hotspots.text: Benches run along the meeting table. There is room to walk around either end without climbing over anyone.

hotspots.title: Speak with the guild worker
hotspots.text: Guild business? Tell me what you need. If you want something for supper, this is the hall, not a member’s shop.

rooms.lore: Secondary guildhall/exterior copper pig vane. Interior plaque and all room design original. A civic meeting/records space, not a slaughterhouse or a meat shop.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Original differentiated production staging informed by current Quill report; not a canonical headquarters floor plan.
rooms.spatialIdentity: Wide shallow whitewashed-brick meeting hall, heavy dark table, red-brown tile and side vestibule.

rooms.name: Bakers’ Guild · Crust Hall

hotspots.title: Demonstration bench
hotspots.text: Bowls, scales and dough occupy the scrubbed demonstration bench. You keep your notebook clear of the flour.

hotspots.title: Hall accounts
hotspots.text: The smaller desk keeps hall accounts apart from the baking work. You can speak to the worker without handling the papers.

hotspots.title: Demonstration oven
hotspots.text: Flour marks the approach to the brick oven. You keep clear of the working area.

hotspots.title: Speak with the guild worker
hotspots.text: Mind the flour near the bench, officer. What do you need? I can listen without putting a thumb in the dough.

rooms.lore: Secondary Crust Hall/training leads. Long hall, demonstration oven, teaching bench and materials original, not a canonical guild plan. No named or dwarf staff inferred. Staffing: original unnamed human support candidate, not a named canonical officer.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Original differentiated production staging informed by current Quill report; not a canonical headquarters floor plan.
rooms.spatialIdentity: Low broad cream-plaster hall, terracotta floor, long pale teaching bench and dominant brick oven.

rooms.name: Lawyers’ Guild · records room

hotspots.title: Secured document records
hotspots.text: Tied bundles sit behind iron mesh. You can see how they are stored, not read what they contain.

hotspots.title: Consultation table
hotspots.text: A small table provides space to speak at the end of the passage. The document stores remain behind their barrier.

hotspots.title: Speak with the records clerk
hotspots.text: What document or person are you asking about? Please begin with that; we can find out how complicated it is afterwards.

rooms.lore: Secondary guild institution/location leads. Not Mr Slant’s firm. Exact file cages, client barrier, plan and materials original; no canonical staff or legal entry rule inferred. Staffing: original unnamed human support candidate, not a named canonical officer.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Original differentiated production staging informed by current Quill report; not a canonical headquarters floor plan.
rooms.spatialIdentity: Narrow deep paper office, iron file cages and bent passage around a central table; olive and burgundy.

rooms.name: Apothecary

hotspots.title: Shelves of jars
hotspots.text: Jars of dried leaves, powders and pickled roots, every one labelled in a neat, tiny hand. Some labels are in a language you don’t read.

hotspots.title: The workbench
hotspots.text: A pestle and mortar, a brass balance and a small burner. Something green simmers gently. It smells of mint and something underneath the mint.

hotspots.title: Speak with the apothecary
hotspots.text: Cough, sprain or nerves? I sell remedies, officer, not miracles. And I keep a poison book, signed, like the law says. You can look at it any time.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Apothecary. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 4 x 5 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Smithy

hotspots.title: The forge
hotspots.text: Coals glow under the hood. Tongs and hammers hang in a neat row, each worn bright where the hand goes.

hotspots.title: Ironwork
hotspots.text: Hinges, hooks, a set of manacles that look Watch issue, and a gate latch waiting to be collected.

hotspots.title: Speak with the smith
hotspots.text: Mind the sparks. If it’s about those manacles, they’re for the Yard, paid in advance. Mostly in advance.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Smithy. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 5 x 5 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Curry house

hotspots.title: The ovens
hotspots.text: Flatbreads puff and blister against the hot brick. The whole room smells of cumin, smoke and something very hot.

hotspots.title: The long table
hotspots.text: Bowls, spoons and a jug of something cooling. Dock workers eat here at all hours and pay in coin, mostly.

hotspots.title: Speak with the cook
hotspots.text: Sit, eat, officer. First bowl is mild. The second is how we make it for ourselves. No one has asked for a third.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Curry house. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 4 x 5 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Butcher’s shop

hotspots.title: The long table
hotspots.text: Scrubbed boards, a row of cleavers and a ledger of orders. Everything here is weighed twice.

hotspots.title: Hooks and rails
hotspots.text: Joints hang along the rail, each with a paper tag and a name.

hotspots.title: Speak with the butcher
hotspots.text: Clean scales, clean counter, licence on the wall. If anyone says otherwise, send them to me. I’ll weigh them.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Butcher’s shop. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 3 x 4 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Cooper’s workshop

hotspots.title: Barrels in progress
hotspots.text: Staves stacked to dry, half-hooped casks and a cask for the docks waiting for its lid.

hotspots.title: The workbench
hotspots.text: Adzes, drawknives and a crozier, laid out in the order they’re used.

hotspots.title: Speak with the cooper
hotspots.text: A good barrel holds anything, officer. A bad one holds anything for about a week. I make the good sort.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Cooper’s workshop. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 6 x 7 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Pawnbroker

hotspots.title: The counter
hotspots.text: A long counter with a brass rail, a ledger open to today and a pen on a chain.

hotspots.title: Pigeonholes
hotspots.text: Hundreds of small parcels, each tagged with a number and a date. Some dates are very old.

hotspots.title: Speak with the pawnbroker
hotspots.text: Everything here has a ticket and every ticket has a name. If you’re looking for something particular, give me the description and I’ll give you the book.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Pawnbroker. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 3 x 4 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Lodging house

hotspots.title: The benches
hotspots.text: Hard benches and a stove. A few lodgers doze sitting up; it costs less than a bed.

hotspots.title: The ledger desk
hotspots.text: Names, nights and pennies paid, in a firm hand. Several names are clearly made up.

hotspots.title: Speak with the landlady
hotspots.text: Penny a night on the bench, tuppence for a bed, and no fighting after the lamps are out. Who are you after?

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Lodging house. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 6 x 6 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Quay lodging

hotspots.title: Sea chests
hotspots.text: Battered chests with rope handles, each with a lodger’s mark burned into the lid.

hotspots.title: The stove
hotspots.text: A kettle that is never quite off the boil, and oilskins steaming on pegs.

hotspots.title: Speak with the keeper
hotspots.text: Sailors pay by the tide, not the night. If someone’s missed his ship, he’ll be here sulking. If he’s caught it, he won’t.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Quay lodging. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 4 x 6 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Cobbler

hotspots.title: The workbench
hotspots.text: Lasts, awls and a pot of wax. A pair of boots waits with a chit tied to the laces.

hotspots.title: Shelves of boots
hotspots.text: Mended boots in a row, each with a name. A few have waited a long time for their owners.

hotspots.title: Speak with the cobbler
hotspots.text: Heels while you wait, soles by Thursday. And no, I don’t lend boots to anyone “just for an evening”.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Cobbler. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 4 x 5 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Ship chandler

hotspots.title: Caged stores
hotspots.text: Lanterns, blocks, rope and tins of ship’s biscuit, locked behind iron mesh.

hotspots.title: The counter
hotspots.text: Orders for three ships pinned up, two of them overdue for payment.

hotspots.title: Speak with the chandler
hotspots.text: I supply ships, officer. Rope, tar, lamps, biscuit. If a ship sails without paying me, I’d very much like to know where to.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Ship chandler. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 4 x 5 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Bonded warehouse

hotspots.title: Shelves of goods
hotspots.text: Rows of crates and bales, each with a bond number chalked on the side.

hotspots.title: The doorway
hotspots.text: A heavy door with two locks. The clerk has one key; the excise man has the other.

hotspots.title: Speak with the clerk
hotspots.text: Nothing leaves without two signatures, officer. Mine, and whoever’s paid the duty. Today that’s nobody, so nothing’s leaving.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Bonded warehouse. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 6 x 7 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Rope-maker’s shed

hotspots.title: The long walk
hotspots.text: A long, bare floor for laying rope, with hooks at either end and coils waiting to be twisted.

hotspots.title: Coils of rope
hotspots.text: Hemp, tarred and plain, sold by the fathom. A length has been cut off one coil very recently.

hotspots.title: Speak with the rope-maker
hotspots.text: Rope’s rope, officer, until someone uses it for something they shouldn’t. Then it’s evidence, and I want it back.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Rope-maker’s shed. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 4 x 5 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).

rooms.name: Barrel-maker

hotspots.title: Half-made casks
hotspots.text: Staves bound in a hoop, waiting for the fire to bend them. Curls of shaving drift round your boots.

hotspots.title: The shaving horse
hotspots.text: A bench you sit astride to shave a stave. The drawknife is sharp enough to make you careful just looking at it.

hotspots.title: Speak with the barrel-maker
hotspots.text: Small casks, officer: firkins, kegs, a pin for a pub. The big yard by the docks does the hogsheads. I do the ones people carry home.

rooms.lore: Street building interior: Barrel-maker. Painting from art/street-interiors-v1, fitted to the 4 x 5 exterior.
rooms.layoutProvenance: Floor from the art packet registration; furniture footprints placed by eye (tools/fit-street-interiors.py).
